 ORDER

This is the third criminal appeal filed by the appellant for grant of regular bail under section14-A(2)
of SC & ST ( Prevention of Atrocities) Act relating to FIR No. 481/2021 registered at P.S - Kanadiya,
Indore, District- Indore (M.P.) for the offence under sections 376, 376(2)(n),450, 354(c), 506 of IPC and sections 3(2)(v), 3(1)(w)(i) of SC and ST Act and section 66 (E) of I.T. Act.

sentences.text: 2/ Learned counsel for the appellant submits that appellant's first bail application was dismissed on merit vide order dated 13/12/2021 and second bail application was dismissed as withdrawn vide order dated 01/03/2023.

sentences.text: seized mobile phone within one month
, but the prosecution has failed to produce the same before the trial Court .The appellant is suffering jail incarceration since 19/08/2021 Final conclusion of trial shall take sufficient long time.
Under the above circumstances, prayer for grant of bail may be considered on such terms and conditions, as this Court deems fit and proper.

4/ Per-contra, learned counsel for respondent " State opposes the bail application and prays for its rejection by stating that the present appeal is not maintainable as the appellant has not filed any separate application for grant of bail.
5/ Both the parties heard and perused the record also.
6/ This Court after considering all the facts and circumstances of the case in detail, rejected the first bail application.
Thereafter, trial was going on.
Although the prosecution has failed to produce FSL report, but at later stage, the prosecution is free to file FSL report.
There is no material change in the circumstances, in which the appellant is entitled for enlargement on bail.

7/ Accordingly, this third criminal appeal filed by the appellant has no force and is hereby dismissed.
